string.text: The Yantar scientific field team supplier. Provides ammunition for protecting expeditions against mutants and records field trials.
Caliber. Expedition field supply. Hunting mutants? Tell me your caliber.
Buckshot, expanding rounds and hunting slugs. The next shipment follows the regular trader schedule.

I supply the field teams. Sakharov studies specimens; I help the people collecting them come back alive. Buckshot for packs, expanding rounds for soft targets. Hunting slugs, heavy buckshot and .338 Federal for larger creatures. I do not stock armor-piercing or general military ammunition.
How do I unlock more supplies?

Ecologist goodwill: initially 20/12 gauge buckshot and expanding 9x18. At 500: 9x19 JHP and .45 Hydro-Shok. At 1000: expanding 5.45x39 and 5.56x45. At 1500: .357 HP and 12-gauge hunting slugs. At 2000: 23x75 buckshot and .338 Federal. Earlier goods remain available. New goods arrive with the next regular restock. Losing goodwill closes access to higher categories.
How do I earn the scientists' trust?

Help expeditions and complete Ecologist jobs. I use the same faction goodwill as Sakharov. Your rank and purchases do not replace that trust. These rounds favor unarmored targets; no promises of killing every creature with one shot.
